g.title: Sheet.47
g.desc: 1. Interfaces must be in the same subnet. 2. OSPF Authenticat...
g.text: 1. Interfaces’ IPs must be in the same subnet.2. An interface must not be Passive.3. OSPF Authentication must pass (if any).4. Hello/Dead timers must match.5. Both RIDs must be unique.6. Interfaces must be in the same Area.

g.title: Sheet.48
g.desc: 1. Interface must be UP/UP. 2. ACL must not filter OSPF messa...
g.text: 1. Interface must be UP/UP.2. ACL must not filter OSPF messages.3. MTU must match.4. Network Type must match.
